title: Effective etale descent for finite etale morphisms
statement: Let $g:Y'\to Y$ be a surjective [def-weil-surjective-morphism] etale [def-weil-etale-morphism] morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] (for instance $Y'=\coprod_iY_i$ for an etale covering $\{Y_i\to Y\}$), and put $Y''=Y'\times_YY'$, $Y'''=Y'\times_YY'\times_YY'$ (fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product]) with projections $p_1,p_2:Y''\to Y'$ and $p_{12},p_{13},p_{23}:Y'''\to Y''$. Let $\mathsf{DD}$ be the category whose objects are pairs $(P',\varphi)$ of a finite etale $Y'$-scheme $P'$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] and a descent datum on $P'$ over $Y'/Y$ [def-pd-descent-datum], i.e. an isomorphism $\varphi:p_1^*P'\cong p_2^*P'$ of schemes over $Y''$ satisfying $p_{13}^*\varphi=p_{23}^*\varphi\circ p_{12}^*\varphi$ over $Y'''$, and whose morphisms $(P',\varphi)\to(Q',\chi)$ are the $Y'$-morphisms $\beta:P'\to Q'$ with $\chi\circ p_1^*\beta=p_2^*\beta\circ\varphi$. For a finite etale $Y$-scheme $P$ let $\mathrm{can}_P:p_1^*(P\times_YY')\to p_2^*(P\times_YY')$ be the composite of the canonical isomorphisms of both sides with $P\times_YY''$ (they exist since $g\circ p_1=g\circ p_2$). Then the functor $\mathsf{FEt}(Y)\to\mathsf{DD}$, $P\mapsto(P\times_YY',\mathrm{can}_P)$, $\alpha\mapsto\alpha\times_YY'$, is an equivalence of categories: the category of finite etale $Y$-schemes is equivalent to the category of finite etale $Y'$-schemes endowed with a descent datum.

proof.text: Construct F and q with their pullback, transport and morphism equations by finiteEtaleDescent_data.

Use finiteEtaleDescent_fullyFaithful to obtain Full and Faithful, and finiteEtaleDescent_essSurj to obtain EssSurj. These give the IsEquivalence structure. Return this F and q with the original equations.

lean.statement: theorem finiteEtaleDescent {Y Y' : Scheme.{v}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [Surjective g] [Etale g] : ∃ (F : Y.FiniteEtale ⥤ AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteEtaleDescentData g) (q : ∀ P : Y.FiniteEtale, (F.obj P).obj.V.left ⟶ P.obj.left), Nonempty F.IsEquivalence ∧ (∀ P : Y.FiniteEtale, ∃ hq : q P ≫ P.obj.hom = (F.obj P).obj.V.hom ≫ g, IsPullback (q P) (F.obj P).obj.V.hom P.obj.hom g ∧ ∀ {T : Scheme.{v}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ Y') (h : f₁ ≫ g = f₂ ≫ g) (z : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ (F.obj P).obj.V), ((F.obj P).obj.datum.transport f₁ f₂ h z).left ≫ q P = z.left ≫ q P) ∧ ∀ P Q : Y.FiniteEtale, ∀ f : P ⟶ Q, (F.map f).hom.hom.left ≫ q Q = q P ≫ f.hom.left
